name: ai-colony
description: AI Colony V1 control plane. Milestone 3 adds LangGraph workflows and OpenAI-compatible local inference on top of IACP.

scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.health: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database packages/inference --pretty false && tsx apps/api/src/runtime-health-cli.ts
scripts.ledger:ready: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database --pretty false && tsx apps/api/src/ledger-readiness-cli.ts
scripts.routing:ready: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database --pretty false && tsx apps/api/src/routing-readiness-cli.ts
scripts.colony:provision: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database packages/inference packages/workflows --pretty false && tsx packages/database/src/colony-cli.ts provision
scripts.colony:start: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database packages/inference packages/workflows --pretty false && tsx packages/database/src/colony-cli.ts start
scripts.colony:restart: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database packages/inference packages/workflows --pretty false && tsx packages/database/src/colony-cli.ts restart
scripts.colony:start:mock: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database packages/inference packages/workflows --pretty false && tsx packages/database/src/colony-cli.ts start-mock
scripts.colony:routing:activate: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database packages/inference packages/workflows --pretty false && tsx packages/database/src/colony-cli.ts routing-activate
scripts.colony:routing:deactivate: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/database packages/inference packages/workflows --pretty false && tsx packages/database/src/colony-cli.ts routing-deactivate
